items.html: *However, the spirit of the first head, because of its high superiority, could not be clothed in any limb, except in the aspect of the breath coming out of the mouth; and even this is not attainable now, but only in the future, when our fathers will merit to be clothed in it. And the second head is not so hidden as it, and therefore it was clothed below, in the secret of the hairs of the beard of the holy Atika, which are more material than the breath of the mouth; but still they are not the aspect of an actual limb. But the third head spread to the nose of the holy Atika, which is an essential limb; and that breath coming out from there is drawn from the third head, called the Moach Stimaa.
